question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Final query: top 3 revenue films per actor + average revenue per actor
WITH film_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    i.film_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    fa.actor_id,
    fa.film_id,
    fr.total_revenue / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.film_id) AS actor_share
  FROM film_actor fa
  JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    film_id,
    actor_share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY actor_share DESC) AS rn
  FROM actor_film_revenue
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT actor_id, film_id, actor_share
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 3
),
actor_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    ROUND(AVG(actor_share), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_actor
  FROM top3
  GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT 
  a.actor_id,
  a.first_name,
  a.last_name,
  f.title AS film_title,
  ROUND(t3.actor_share, 2) AS film_revenue,
  aa.avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3 t3
JOIN actor a ON t3.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON t3.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN actor_avg aa ON t3.actor_id = aa.actor_id
ORDER BY a.actor_id, t3.actor_share DESC
